notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - Major Update
notes.content:
[b]New Endgame Content: Post-Phantom Challenges[/b]
I’ve heard your feedback! Defeating the Phantom is now only the beginning. Time to crank up the challenge.

[b]Challenge Mode[/b]
After defeating the standard difficulty, you’ll unlock new challenges. Each one demands careful planning—explore your character roster, evaluate their strengths, and assemble the perfect team to conquer each test.

[b]A new ending[/b]
Complete all the challenges, and you’ll unlock a brand-new final boss. Who—or what—is waiting at the end? You’ll have to rise to the challenge to find out.

[b]Difficulty settings[/b]
Where have the difficulty settings gone? These aren’t gone. Each one is now integrated into a different challenge. You no longer have to complete them multiple times to unlock the next one, so hopefully this will be less grindy overall. Nightmare is now the final challenge, with a new look boss at the end.
